Politics · India

Student Protests Lead to Education Minister's Resignation

Following weeks of student protests, India's Education Minister resigned on July 25. The protests, initially met with silence from Prime Minister Modi, gained momentum and were described as a victory for the youth-led "Cockroach" movement. The resignation has been framed by some as a significant political development, potentially shifting the debate and creating a platform for reform, while others express concern about potential repression.
